name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-super-mario-land-2
title: Super Mario World Styled Super Mario Land 2: 6 Golden Coins Grassland
description:
A tileset that i edited off from PaperWario's Super Mario Land 2: 6 Golden Coins - Level 1-1 with SMW Styled Graphics and Palette.

It also includes the full titleset unlike the original when some tiles are not changed.

It can overwrite the original SMW grass titleset with this one.

Credit goes to PaperWario for the original titleset.
